la-mort-i-la-primavera-bellini-2026.title: La mort i la primavera by Marcos Morau and La Veronal at the Bellini
la-mort-i-la-primavera-bellini-2026.blurb: The Catalan company La Veronal turns Mercè Rodoreda's novel into dance, with Marcos Morau's striking choreography. Just three performances: Friday at 8.45pm, Saturday at 7pm, Sunday at 6pm.

emigranti-bellini-2026.title: Emigranti by Mrożek at the Teatro Bellini
emigranti-bellini-2026.blurb: Valerio Santoro and Claudio Casadio play the two emigrants shut in a basement in Sławomir Mrożek's play, directed by Leo Muscato. There's a Wednesday matinee at 5.30pm, handy if you'd rather not make it a late one.

neanche-parenti-piccolo-bellini-2026.title: Neanche parenti at the Piccolo Bellini
neanche-parenti-piccolo-bellini-2026.blurb: A new play written and directed by Gabriele Russo and Arianna D'Angiò, running for almost a month in the Bellini's small studio theatre. Tickets are cheaper on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, and on Sundays it starts at 6.30pm.

maccio-capatonda-bellini-2026.title: Maccio Capatonda's stage debut at the Bellini
maccio-capatonda-bellini-2026.blurb: A play about a play: a desperate theatre company talks the Italian comedian Maccio Capatonda into going on stage to save the theatre, with his alter ego appearing on video. Four nights and tickets go fast: the cheapest seats in the third tier start at €30 plus booking fee.

txt-festival-mercadante-2026.title: TXT Festival with Martin Crimp at the Mercadante and San Ferdinando
txt-festival-mercadante-2026.blurb: Four days of European playwriting with Martin Crimp as guest: readings, his opera Written on Skin, shows in the Ridotto studio and, after midnight, DJ sets and after-show parties with free entry. Check the programme night by night, as some tickets cover two shows back to back.
txt-festival-mercadante-2026.place: Teatro Mercadante and Teatro San Ferdinando

ultimo-nastro-krapp-mercadante-2026.title: L'ultimo nastro di Krapp and Press Conference with Renato Carpentieri at the Mercadante
ultimo-nastro-krapp-mercadante-2026.blurb: Roberto Andò pairs Beckett and Pinter in a double bill about memory and power, carried entirely by Renato Carpentieri. On weekdays the side boxes cost €13, and there are 5pm matinees.

uscita-di-emergenza-san-ferdinando-2026.title: Uscita di emergenza by Santanelli at the Teatro San Ferdinando
uscita-di-emergenza-san-ferdinando-2026.blurb: Vincenzo Ferrera and Nando Paone in Manlio Santanelli's classic about two men stuck in a crumbling house after the earthquake. Seats up in the gallery start at €13 on weekdays.

serafino-gubbio-ridotto-mercadante-2026.title: Quaderni di Serafino Gubbio operatore at the Ridotto del Mercadante
serafino-gubbio-ridotto-mercadante-2026.blurb: Flavio Capuzzo Dolcetta adapts Pirandello's novel about cinema and the man reduced to turning a camera handle, in the Ridotto's intimate studio. Saturday at 7pm, Sunday at 6pm.

la-vasca-bonaiuto-mercadante-2026.title: La vasca with Anna Bonaiuto at the Teatro Mercadante
la-vasca-bonaiuto-mercadante-2026.blurb: Anna Bonaiuto performs Franco Marcoaldi's play, directed by Andrea Renzi. There are several 5pm matinees, handy if you finish work in the centre.

lisola-san-ferdinando-2026.title: L'isola with Cristina Donadio and Bianca Nappi at the Teatro San Ferdinando
lisola-san-ferdinando-2026.blurb: Two mothers in a hospital waiting room, forced to tell each other everything: Juan Carlos Rubio's play, directed by Marcello Cotugno. Saturday at 7pm, Sunday at 6pm, gallery seats from €13.

trianondanza-2026.title: TrianonDanza 2026 at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
trianondanza-2026.blurb: A contemporary dance season with companies from Campania, from Gabriella Stazio to Körper Young and Fabrizio Varriale, almost every night until mid-October. One price of €5 for everything, so you can take a chance on a name you've never heard of.

venere-vs-adone-trianon-2026.title: Venere vs Adone by Enzo Cosimi at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
venere-vs-adone-trianon-2026.blurb: Dance theatre by Enzo Cosimi that moves through a world of images from Andy Warhol to Marlene Dumas. Saturday at 9pm, Sunday at 6pm.

figlio-della-tempesta-trianon-2026.title: Il figlio della tempesta by Armando Punzo at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
figlio-della-tempesta-trianon-2026.blurb: Armando Punzo and Andrea Salvadori with the Compagnia della Fortezza, the group that has been making theatre inside Volterra prison for over thirty years. Two performances, Saturday evening and Sunday at 6pm.

teardo-bargeld-trianon-2026.title: Teho Teardo and Blixa Bargeld in concert at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
teardo-bargeld-trianon-2026.blurb: The composer Teho Teardo and the voice of Einstürzende Neubauten, who also played with Nick Cave, perform together with strings, electronics and song. A single date in Forcella, tickets on Vivaticket.

dada-fiabe-donna-ruvia-trianon-2026.title: Dadà, Le fiabe di donna Ruvia at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
dada-fiabe-donna-ruvia-trianon-2026.blurb: A concert-show by Dadà, a singer-songwriter from the new Neapolitan scene, somewhere between songwriting and contemporary sounds. Saturday at 9pm, Sunday afternoon at 6pm.

pinocchio-iodice-trianon-2026.title: Pinocchio, che cos'è una persona? by Davide Iodice at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
pinocchio-iodice-trianon-2026.blurb: The show by Davide Iodice's Scuola elementare del teatro, winner of a special Ubu award (Italy's top theatre prize), with disabled and non-disabled actors. Friday and Saturday at 9pm, Sunday at 6pm.

serena-rossi-serenata-diana-2026.title: Serena Rossi in Serenata a Napoli at the Teatro Diana
serena-rossi-serenata-diana-2026.blurb: Serena Rossi tells and sings Naples as a siren and a female city, in a show directed by Cristina Redini. Three weeks of performances, with matinees on Wednesdays at 5.45pm and Sundays at 6pm.

otello-diana-2026.title: Otello with Giacomo Giorgio and Giorgio Pasotti at the Teatro Diana
otello-diana-2026.blurb: Giacomo Giorgio, known from the TV series Mare fuori, plays Othello, and Giorgio Pasotti directs a script by Dacia Maraini. On Saturdays there are two shows, at 5.30pm and 9pm.

ozpetek-ruoli-secondari-diana-2026.title: Ruoli secondari by Ferzan Ozpetek at the Teatro Diana
ozpetek-ruoli-secondari-diana-2026.blurb: The new show written and directed by Ferzan Ozpetek, after bringing his films Mine vaganti and Magnifica presenza to the stage. On Saturdays choose between 5.30pm and 9pm, on Sundays it's 6pm.

fratelli-de-filippo-rubini-diana-2026.title: I fratelli De Filippo by Sergio Rubini at the Teatro Diana
fratelli-de-filippo-rubini-diana-2026.blurb: Sergio Rubini stages Eduardo, Peppino and Titina, the famous Neapolitan theatre siblings, from Maurizio Giammusso's book, with Susy Del Giudice, Marianna Fontana and music by Nicola Piovani. Two weeks in Vomero, with a Wednesday matinee.

cafe-chantant-sannazaro-ottobre-2026.title: Café Chantant My World by Lara Sansone at the Teatro Sannazaro
cafe-chantant-sannazaro-ottobre-2026.blurb: Lara Sansone's show with the Sannazaro's orchestra and dancers, comic sketches and songs from Naples' belle époque. Only three nights in October, then it's back around Christmas.

buccirosso-qualcosa-e-andato-storto-sann.title: Qualcosa è andato storto by Carlo Buccirosso at the Teatro Sannazaro
buccirosso-qualcosa-e-andato-storto-sann.blurb: Carlo Buccirosso writes, directs and plays a small-town lawyer swept up in the quarrels of his entire extended family. Four performances, Sunday at 6pm.

peppe-barra-buonasera-sannazaro-2026.title: Peppe Barra in Buonasera a tutti at the Teatro Sannazaro
peppe-barra-buonasera-sannazaro-2026.blurb: A recital by Peppe Barra mixing songs, stories and masks, talking straight to the audience. Three nights on via Chiaia, and on Sunday it starts at 6pm.

mastelloni-solo-tiny-sannazaro-2026.title: Leopoldo Mastelloni tells Mastelloni at the Teatro TINy Sannazaro
mastelloni-solo-tiny-sannazaro-2026.blurb: Alone on stage, Leopoldo Mastelloni revisits the characters of a career spanning Eduardo, Viviani and Patroni Griffi. A small room with few seats, Saturday at 7pm and Sunday at 6pm.

korper-al-nuovo-teatro-nuovo-2026.title: Körper al Nuovo, four nights of dance at the Teatro Nuovo
korper-al-nuovo-teatro-nuovo-2026.blurb: A dance season curated by Körper, with Compagnie Linga, Zappalà Danza 2, Luna Cenere's Shoes On and the young dancers of Körper Young. Watch the times: on Saturday 17th it starts at 7pm, on Sunday 18th at 6pm.

il-presidente-teatro-nuovo-2026.title: Il presidente with Filippo Nigro at the Teatro Nuovo
il-presidente-teatro-nuovo-2026.blurb: Fabrizio Arcuri and Filippo Nigro restage Davide Carnevali's play, rewritten for the occasion, with plenty of direct contact with the audience. Friday at 6.30pm, Saturday at 7pm, Sunday afternoon.

drag-ring-priscilla-teatro-nuovo-2026.title: Drag Ring with Priscilla at the Teatro Nuovo
drag-ring-priscilla-teatro-nuovo-2026.blurb: Lip sync battles between drag queens hosted by Priscilla, with routines prepared to a playlist they receive in advance. One night only, Saturday at 9pm.

basso-napoletano-galleria-toledo-2026.title: Basso napoletano by Marco Sgrosso at Galleria Toledo
basso-napoletano-galleria-toledo-2026.blurb: Voice and double bass, Marco Sgrosso and Felice Del Gaudio, in a jam session of Neapolitan words from Eduardo onwards. It opens Galleria Toledo's 35th anniversary season, Sunday at 6pm.

il-medico-dei-pazzi-galleria-toledo-2026.title: Il medico dei pazzi by Scarpetta at Galleria Toledo
il-medico-dei-pazzi-galleria-toledo-2026.blurb: Laura Angiulli directs Eduardo Scarpetta's farce with Agostino Chiummariello and a large cast, sets by Rosario Squillace. Almost a month of performances, Fridays at 9pm and Sundays at 6pm.

kid-yugi-palapartenope-2026.title: Kid Yugi at the Teatro Palapartenope
kid-yugi-palapartenope-2026.blurb: The rapper from Puglia brings his platinum album Anche gli eroi muoiono to the indoor arenas. The Palapartenope is a short walk from the Edenlandia stop on the Cumana train, easy for getting home.

anna-tatangelo-casa-della-musica-2026.title: Anna Tatangelo at the Casa della Musica
anna-tatangelo-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: Anna Tatangelo in concert in the hall of the Palapartenope complex, a rescheduled date. If you already had a ticket, it's still valid.

legend-the-show-palapartenope-2026.title: Legend The Show, Michael Jackson with orchestra at the Teatro Palapartenope
legend-the-show-palapartenope-2026.blurb: A Michael Jackson show with live band, orchestra and dancers, led by Wendel Gama and with Jennifer Batten, the guitarist who actually played with him. A night out for families, it finishes around 11pm.

lda-aka7even-casa-della-musica-2026.title: LDA and Aka7even at the Casa della Musica
lda-aka7even-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: The duo behind Poesie clandestine play their joint album and hits from their own repertoires, with a few nods to Neapolitan song. One of three indoor dates this autumn.

dove-liana-duel-club-2026.title: Dov'è Liana live at the Duel Club
dove-liana-duel-club-2026.blurb: The project that brought Italodance back to the dance floor, for a night of Mediterranean sounds at the club in Agnano. Tickets on Dice, best bought in advance.

cassius-duel-club-2026.title: Cassius at the Duel Club
cassius-duel-club-2026.blurb: The French touch of Cassius, the only Italian stop on a tour that takes in Dublin, London and Manchester. Doors at 9.30pm and limited capacity.

gli-anni-capitolo-3-madre-2026.title: Gli anni. Capitolo 3 at the Museo Madre
gli-anni-capitolo-3-madre-2026.blurb: Works by Clemente, Pipilotti Rist, Kabakov, Fischli and others, each tied to the year it was first shown in Campania. The museum is closed on Tuesdays, and at weekends guided tours are included in the ticket.

living-collapse-madre-2026.title: Living Collapse, the nativity scene through contemporary eyes at the Museo Madre
living-collapse-madre-2026.blurb: The second exhibition of the Premio Meridiana: three artists from Campania rethink the tradition of the presepe, the Neapolitan nativity scene, starting from Jimmie Durham's Presepio. It's covered by the same €8 ticket as the other exhibitions.

palazzo-reale-apertura-serale-2-ottobre-.title: Late opening at the Palazzo Reale with stargazing from the Belvedere
palazzo-reale-apertura-serale-2-ottobre-.blurb: The Palazzo Reale stays open until midnight for €5, and for another €5 you can go up to the Belvedere and look at the sky through the telescopes of the Capodimonte Observatory. The same evening Villa Pignatelli is open until 11.30pm for €3.

biasiucci-archetipi-reggia-caserta-2026.title: Archetipi, Antonio Biasiucci at the Reggia di Caserta
biasiucci-archetipi-reggia-caserta-2026.blurb: Over 300 photographs and installations by Antonio Biasiucci, from steam to bread to volcanoes, along the Gran Galleria of the Royal Apartments. It's included in the Reggia ticket, and the palace is closed on Tuesdays.

dorazio-nuti-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: Francesco D'Orazio and Giampaolo Nuti at Villa Pignatelli
dorazio-nuti-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: Violin and piano on a Sunday morning, from Beethoven to Stravinsky, Schnittke and Pärt, in the museum's veranda on the Riviera di Chiaia. Book by phone with Maggio della Musica, there are 199 seats.

uri-caine-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: Uri Caine solo piano at Villa Pignatelli
uri-caine-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: The American pianist Uri Caine plays solo, with a programme called Change, moving between jazz and new takes on the classics. An evening with 199 seats, reduced to €15 for over-65s and under-26s.

il-sosia-schubert-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: Il Sosia, the short life of Schubert at Villa Pignatelli
il-sosia-schubert-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: Piano four hands by Marco Schiavo and Sergio Marchegiani with Stefano Valanzuolo narrating, the life of Schubert told through music. A Sunday matinee for €10, booking required.
